channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: E.l.f. Beauty Raises 2026 Forecasts as Rhode Breaks Records and New Super Bowl Campaign Debuts
item.description: Strong third-quarter results and brand momentum drove higher forecasts.

item.title: Johnston & Murphy, Official Shoe Sponsor of Westminster Dog Show, Outfits Best in Show Winning Handler
item.description: Penny the Doberman Pinscher took home the highest title of the multi-day event, which concluded on Tuesday night at Madison Square Garden in NYC.

item.title: Nike Calls EEOC Action Over White Worker Discrimination Claims a ‘Surprising and Unusual Escalation’
item.description: The EEOC seeks from Nike information related to allegations — some requests go back to 2018 — of DEI-related discrimination against white workers.

item.title: 41 Romantic Gifts for Her to Unwrap This Valentine’s Day (That Will Arrive on Time)
item.description: From pink-powered puffer vests to beauty essentials she'll cherish, show the woman in your life some love with these thoughtful gift ideas.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Cocokind Partners Qith Beverage Brand Olipop on New Ceramide Lip Blur Balm Collection
item.description: The limited-edition line will feature three new flavors: Strawberry Vanilla, Cream Soda and Cherry Cola.

item.title: N4XT Experiences and SAP Partner to Power New Digital and Retail Infrastructure for NYFW
item.description: SAP will support digital platform development, retail activations and designer-first tools.

item.title: Iris to Host Latest Edition of Program Helping Athletes Break Into Business
item.description: Iris Ventures' giveback program, Beyond the Finish Line, helps athletes with financial, brand-building and entrepreneurship tools to help build their post-competitive careers.

item.title: Palace Lands in Hong Kong’s Retail Hot Spot Causeway Bay
item.description: To commemorate the opening, the brand will release several Hong Kong-exclusive pieces, including a nostalgic capsule in collaboration with South China FC.

item.title: Armani Becomes Official Beauty Partner to BAFTA TV, Film Awards in Britain
item.description: The Armani Beauty makeup artists will provide exclusive services to nominees, presenters and VIP guests for their appearances on the red carpets and after parties at all the BAFTA awards this year.

item.title: Tommy Hilfiger Partners With Cadillac Formula 1 Team for Exclusive Fanwear Collection
item.description: The collection marks Cadillac Formula 1 Team's arrival on the grid with Tommy Hilfiger as official apparel partner, ahead of the 2026 season.
